neighbours.label: a second quantity being added or offered as an alternative: the count in 'one X or two Y' and the operand after '+' in arithmetic
fire: Each room has either one large desk or two small tables by the window.
You can order one big pizza or two medium ones for the same price.
The ticket covers either one adult or two children under twelve.
Addition is associative, so (x + y) + z = x + (y + z) for all numbers.
Visitors may bring one suitcase or two small bags on the boat.
The rule says that a + 0 = a and a + b = b + a for whole numbers.
The recipe works with one large egg or two small ones.
Each player may draw one card or two cards from the pile.
quiet: Each room has either a large desk or a pair of small tables by the window.
You can order a big pizza or some smaller ones for the same price.
The ticket covers either an adult or a child under twelve.
Addition is associative, so grouping the numbers differently gives the same total.
Visitors may bring a suitcase or some small bags on the boat.
The rule says that adding nothing changes nothing, and order does not matter.
The recipe works with a large egg or a couple of small ones.
Each player may draw a card or pass to the next player.
